analyst_view.overall: Early view: Trabzonspor (2nd) have won all six league games under Thomas Reis and have the meanest defence (eight conceded), but they are also in the Conference League, where they lost 1-0 at home to Freiburg. Goztepe (10th) under Stoilov won four in a row, including at Fenerbahce, and had won all four home games before Basaksehir beat them 2-1. Monday-night kick-off in Izmir.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. Goztepe's games have been high-scoring (41 goals in eleven), but Trabzonspor have conceded only eight, so the two pull in opposite directions and I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Trabzonspor usually control the ball, but Goztepe were confident enough at home to beat their first four visitors, so the split should be fairly even.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards. A strong home crowd against a title challenger usually lifts the count, but neither side has a reported discipline problem, so I keep it near the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.7 shots and I lean lower. Trabzonspor gave Alanyaspor almost no possession and opponents have struggled to create against them all season, so Goztepe's 16.6 home shots look high.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.0 shots on target. Against the league's best defence I expect Goztepe to manage fewer clear efforts than forecast, so slightly lower.
